t: You're standing in front of the Chindit Memorial, in Victoria Embankment Gardens, close to the Ministry of Defence headquarters. It commemorates the Chindit special forces, who served in Burma under Major General Orde Wingate in the Second World War. It also remembers Wingate himself, who died on active service in Burma in 1944. The memorial was put up in 1990, and the sculptor was Frank Forster. In August 2020 it became a Grade II listed building, so it's now formally protected.
